brief: The canvas features a constantly evolving field of abstract, bioluminescent shapes—spheres, arcs, and ephemeral glyphs—floating in a deep, saturated gradient that mimics dappled light. These forms appear suddenly and dissipate slowly, creating a constant, meditative flicker of insight. When the viewer clicks anywhere on the canvas, the current chaotic patterns pause briefly, and a single, prominent, glowing focal thought instantly draws itself in the center, emanating ripples of color that slowly fade back into the general ambient motion.
